apps/web/src/components/frame/PageScroll.reason: The page-scroll owner's two permanent listeners, installed once at module load like the location store's: a capture click that turns a link to a #fragment of this page into a glide the reader can stop, and the reader's wheel, touch, pointer and key input that stops a glide and ends a #fragment hold. Both are page-wide by nature (any link, any input), and the lint knows only the location store and the page-event registry as owners. The same function starts a body MutationObserver the lint does not count: temporary, it waits for the location store to report, once per path change and after the new page is in the DOM, that a new page is showing (link, push, Back and Forward), without depending on an API a supported browser lacks.

The window scroll listener of one #fragment hold, added in the event that starts the hold and removed in releaseHold when reader input, a reader scroll or the next page ends it: it tells the browser's own scroll anchoring from the reader while the hold runs.

Starts the in-page anchor glide: a frame-by-frame animation of the window scroll (600 to 800 ms ease in-out by distance) that stops at once on reader input; it replaces CSS smooth scrolling because WebKit cannot stop a native smooth scroll the reader interrupts, so each frame is the animation, not an ordering patch
The next frame of the same anchor glide; the loop ends when the glide reaches its target, the page changes or the reader scrolls
